about_short_description.short_description: REMI is a public policy organization that offers model development services.

product.name: PI+
product.description: A dynamic economic model that evaluates the total economic effects of policy changes on regional economies.

product.name: Tax-PI
product.description: A software tool for analyzing the dynamic economic and fiscal effects of tax and other policy changes.

product.name: TranSight
product.description: A software solution for evaluating the total economic effects of transportation policies and investments.

product.name: E3+
product.description: A software tool for analyzing the macroeconomic and demographic impacts of energy and environmental initiatives.

product.name: Regional Forecasting Model
product.description: A structural and dynamic approach to regional economic and demographic forecasting.

product.name: Consulting Services
product.description: Economic consulting services that support policy analysis and decision-making through dynamic economic modeling.
